title: Combination Sum II (No Reuse)
statement:
Given a collection of integers (may contain duplicates) and a target T, count the number of unique combinations that sum to T.

Each number may be used at most once. Two combinations are considered the same if they contain the same multiset of values, regardless of order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and T.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of unique combinations summing to T.

starterCode.python:
line = input().split()
n, t = int(line[0]), int(line[1])
cands = list(map(int, input().split()))
cands.sort()
# Write your solution here
# Hint: sort; skip duplicates at same depth level; use each element at most once
